notes: «كلاهما عن بشر» joins three co-transmitters in one level although the word says two; the three names are read as written.
The dashed remark «- قال أبو كامل حدثنا بشر بن المفضل -» is the same man as «بشر», written fuller: one link, not a route.
«يحيى، بن عمارة» keeps the comma as the text writes it.
